generation_settings.method: Existing approved agent authors every scenario and teacher label; deterministic CPU compilation only.
generation_settings.option_order: Balanced per split and option count; shuffled target slots independent of case content; distractors shuffled separately.
generation_settings.question: What does the customer want?

usage_constraints.origin: Original synthetic requests and labels generated under existing provider terms.
usage_constraints.redistribution: No independent redistribution-license claim; subject to applicable provider terms.
usage_constraints.privacy: No private records or real customer documents used.
usage_constraints.features: Only state, question, and option texts are model inputs; exclude IDs and provenance.

limitations: All labels are teacher-authored; same-session review is not independent correctness verification.
Teacher immutable revision and sampling configuration unavailable.
No tokenizer or model loaded; parent must perform the 256-token audit.
No historical examples or evaluation data inspected; parent must check historical overlap and aggregate uniqueness.
Lexical overlap and explicit scope phrases may remain predictive; this is not a claim of shortcut-free data.
Ten scenarios per domain provide limited coverage of that domain.
